summary: Enroll in our Integrated Farming Systems Course and gain essential skills to implement sustainable farming practices that maximize yield and minimize waste.
lede: Integrated farm and environmental planning connects crop, livestock, water, labour, and financial decisions across a whole farm. For farm managers, agronomists, livestock officers, and extension advisers, this training offers a practical way to assess mixed-farm performance and select feasible improvements. Learners practise mapping farm flows, assessing enterprise performance, and prioritizing interventions through indicators and an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This integrated farming systems course is designed for agricultural professionals who need to connect production, resource, financial, and sustainability decisions across a whole farm.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have foundation-level exposure to agricultural production, farm management, extension, or sustainability work. Technology: Bring a laptop with a current web browser, a spreadsheet application, and QGIS installed for mapping exercises. Programming: Coding requirement: none. Data: You may bring non-confidential farm records, or use the datasets and farm scenarios supplied during the course.
